dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregularly shaped circular and semi-circular high-contrast perimeters with jagged, scalloped edges. Sharp transitions exist between the high-intensity white outer rings and the low-intensity dark interior centers of prominent 'O' and 'C' structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, asymmetrical, high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated along the dorsal ridge and inter-annuli spaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli (central-dorsal, anterior-lateral, and posterior-dorsal) form a wide-angled obtuse scalene triangle with the longest axis oriented longitudinally.
